Based on the search results you provided, my top pick is the ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25W if you want the fastest charging, while the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand is the strongest choice for a traditional bedside stand based on WIRED’s testing.

Here are my top three picks, using only your pasted results.

Best for fast charging
1. ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Magnetic Charging Station Qi2.2 25W
$82 with discount code

Charges an iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods, with active cooling to help manage heat. Supports up to 25W Qi2.2 charging on compatible iPhones and includes a 50W adapter.

Why buy it: Fast charging, cooling fan and a complete charging setup in one stand.

Watch out: The full 25W speed is limited to specific iPhone models; other compatible iPhones charge more slowly.

Buy from ESR's official US store · Offer details and code

Source: Dealectric, offer checked October 23, 2026

Best overall stand
2. Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand
$98 at Belkin; other listings from $80

WIRED's overall pick features an adjustable magnetic phone mount, a dedicated Apple Watch charger and an AirPods charging base. Supports up to 15W iPhone charging and fast charging for Apple Watch Series 7 and newer.

Why buy it: A polished, stable stand for a nightstand or desk, with adjustable viewing angles and landscape orientation support.

Watch out: Its 15W iPhone charging is slower than the newer 25W options.

Shop through WIRED's buying guide

Source: WIRED, updated September 2026

Best adjustable design
3. Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand Qi2 25W
$129.99

Offers up to 25W Qi2 charging, Apple Watch fast charging, an adjustable phone mount and a foldable design. A 45W power adapter is included.

Why buy it: Great for a desk where you want to see your phone during calls, or for travel when you want a stand that folds away.

Watch out: More expensive than the ESR offer, and its foldable design may be unnecessary for a permanent nightstand setup.

My final recommendation

Buy the ESR CryoBoost if you have a compatible iPhone and want high charging speeds at the lowest price among these three.

Buy the Belkin if you mainly want a stylish, dependable bedside stand and don't need 25W charging.

Buy the Satechi if adjustability and portability matter most.

One important detail: Qi2 25W support doesn't mean every iPhone will charge at 25W. Check your exact iPhone model before purchasing.
